quarterly_data.quarter: Renesas press release: Renesas Launches RX74M and RX74N Flagship 32-bit MCUs, (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Renesas launched the RX74M and RX74N flagship 32-bit MCUs, available today: up to 600 MHz (300 MHz versions with more than 20% lower power consumption), the first RX Family devices built on a 22nm process with embedded MRAM; RX74M supports EtherCAT, TSN-capable Gigabit Ethernet and CAN FD on one device, with hardware security for Cyber Resilience Act compliance and post-quantum cryptography support.
